Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a mandatory occupational disease exposure reporting requirement for firefighters.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a mandatory occupational diseaseexposure reporting requirement for firefighters; creating a newsection; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Beginning July 1, 2014, the departmentof labor and industries shall convene a work group to discussestablishing definitions, policies, and procedures for mandatoryreporting of hazardous exposures suffered in the course of employmentby firefighters. (2) The work group must include, at a minimum, stakeholdersrepresenting firefighter unions, fire departments, fire chiefs, andselfinsured employers. (3) By December 31, 2014, the department must report to theappropriate committees of the legislature any recommendations forlegislation or rule making. (4) This section expires January 31, 2015.
